question.title: Will Germany beat Serbia in their UEFA Nations League match on 13 November 2026?
question.description:
The UEFA Nations League 2026/27 league phase runs from September to November 2026. League A Group A2 contains Germany, the Netherlands, Greece and Serbia, who meet home and away over six matchdays. Four matchdays were completed by 4 October 2026: UEFA's standings show the Netherlands and Greece level on 8 points, Germany third on 5 points (one win, two draws, one defeat; 3 goals for, 2 against) and Serbia bottom on 0 points (four defeats, 3 goals for, 8 against) — https://www.uefa.com/uefanationsleague/standings/

Germany, under head coach Jürgen Klopp, drew 1-1 in the Netherlands (24 Sep), lost 0-1 at home to Greece (27 Sep), beat Serbia 2-0 at home (1 Oct) and drew 0-0 in Greece (4 Oct); UEFA's form guide reads DDLWD (https://www.uefa.com/uefanationsleague/teams/47--germany/matches). Serbia has lost all four matches and can no longer reach the group's top two places. With the top two in each League A group progressing to the knockout stage, Germany's remaining fixtures are this away trip to Belgrade (matchday 5) and a home game against the Netherlands on 16 November 2026 — https://editorial.uefa.com/resources/02a7-213a07364ee1-2e150950fd04-1000/unl_2627_-_league_phase_fixture_list_per_matchday_28_july_2026.pdf

The fixture is scheduled for Friday 13 November 2026 at Stadion Rajko Mitić in Belgrade, kick-off 20:45 CET (19:45 UTC); UEFA's head-to-head record lists 17 Germany wins, 5 draws and 8 Serbia wins across previous meetings. Squad selections, injuries and travel news are typically confirmed in the 48 hours before kick-off, and Serbia has an incentive to salvage a result at home after a winless campaign so far, while Germany needs points to keep pace with the Netherlands and Greece.

question.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves based on the result of the UEFA Nations League 2026/27 league-phase match Serbia vs Germany, scheduled for 13 November 2026, as recorded on UEFA's official match page for the fixture: https://www.uefa.com/uefanationsleague/match/2047887--serbia-vs-germany/

It resolves Yes if the final score shown on that page is a Germany win — i.e. Germany scores more goals than Serbia over the match's 90 minutes plus stoppage time. It resolves No if the final score is a draw or a Serbia win.
question.fine_print: If the fixture is not played as scheduled (postponed, abandoned or replayed), the question resolves on the result of the Serbia vs Germany Nations League fixture once UEFA records a final result, including a result awarded by disciplinary decision; if UEFA records the fixture as annulled with no result, the question is annulled. Changes to venue or attendance (e.g. behind closed doors) do not affect resolution.
